convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for XMA_Ichimoku_Channel indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator with multiple non-standard smoothing methods requires replication in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp of last buy signal
DnSignalTime - timestamp of last sell signal

other_exits: Close long when price falls below lower channel (SELL_Close triggered by iClose[1]<DnValue[1])
Close short when price rises above upper channel (BUY_Close triggered by iClose[1]>UpValue[1])

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values = share of deposit fraction. Default MM=-0.1 means 0.1 fixed lots.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a two-bar confirmation: previous bar (index [1]) must confirm the channel breakout direction, and current bar (index [0]) must show a crossover back into/out of channel. Specifically: BUY_Open requires iClose[1]>UpValue[1] AND iClose[0]<=UpValue[0] (price was above upper channel on previous bar and crossed back below on current bar). SELL_Open requires iClose[1]<DnValue[1] AND iClose[0]>=DnValue[0] (price was below lower channel and crossed back above). This is a mean-reversion channel strategy - entering on return to channel after breakout. The SignalBar input (default 1) shifts which bar is used for signal evaluation. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates every tick without new-bar guard. The Recount mechanism retries data copying on failure. Position open/close permissions are independently configurable via input booleans.
python_conversion_notes: 1. Must replicate XMA_Ichimoku_Channel custom indicator - it uses 10 smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA are non-standard and require full algorithm porting. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory - these wrap order sending, position checking, lot calculation, and history loading. Must be reimplemented. 3. The MM parameter dual logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. 4. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so need _Point multiplication in Python. 5. The two-bar crossover logic is counter-intuitive: buy triggers when price crosses BACK INTO the channel from above (mean reversion), not on breakout. 6. Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + PeriodSeconds for trade execution timestamp tracking. 7. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles new-bar detection - must replicate.
